name: Himalayan Salt N Pepper Makhana
ingredients_raw: Makhana (Fox Nuts - 70%), Edible Vegetable Oil (Sunflower), Seasoning [Maltodextrin, Sugar, Himalayan Salt (1.4%), Black Salt (1.4%), Flavours [Natural (Spice), Nature Identical (Lemon)], Spice & Condiments (Black Pepper (0.4%), Yellow Chilli, Cinnamon), Lemon Juice Powder, Onion Powder, Hydrolysed Vegetable Protein, Garlic Powder, Yeast Extract, Anticaking Agent (INS 551), Flavour Enhancers (INS 627, INS 631)].
